title: Componentwise invertibility of the refinement-restriction map
statement: For every M : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (R.ring X)), the specified map refinementRestriction R r hi M is an isomorphism.

from.place: Componentwise invertibility substep of the refinement restriction proof.

proof.text: Use the clopen distinguished section in the refinement fibre product. Open pullback preserves the chosen K-injective models, the ringed open-closed calculation identifies the section extension by zero, and the derived pullback compositor identifies its proper direct image with the identity. The proper counit restricted to this section is therefore invertible, and composing with the pullback compositor gives the specified refinementRestriction component.
